---
title: "Data notes"
description: "Where the data comes from, and what is missing."
---


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
data(penguins)
```
:::


The data are included in base R as `datasets::penguins` (R ≥ 4.5), so there is nothing to download. It
is the Palmer Station penguin survey, the same data used in the analysis page.

Here is what is missing, by column:


::: {#tbl-missing .cell tbl-cap='Missing values per measurement column.'}

```{.r .cell-code}
penguins |>
  summarise(across(c(bill_len, bill_dep, body_mass), \(x) sum(is.na(x)))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}


| bill_len| bill_dep| body_mass|
|--------:|--------:|---------:|
|        2|        2|         2|


:::
:::


Dropping incomplete rows removes only a few observations.
